The '''Tanta Aurek system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]]<ref name="gazetteer" /> in the [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]]<ref name="gazetteer-map" /> of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]],<ref name="outersec" /> on the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]].<ref name="gazetteer-map" /> Its name originated from the phenomenon that its [[Star/Legends|sun]], [[Tanta Aurek]], and the star of the [[Tanta Besh system/Legends|Tanta Besh system]], [[Tanta Besh]], appeared as a double star in the sky of the planet [[Obica]]. The system contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Scelepas]].<ref name="gazetteer" />
